title: Open a meal package
why: Step 'Get it ready' needs you to take off the box and open the film.

steps.text: Take the meal out of the box or sleeve
Find the corner of the film. It may say "Peel"
Hold the tray flat with one hand. Pull the corner with your other hand
Package says "Vent" or "Poke"? Poke a few small holes with a fork instead

tips: Film won't peel? Leave it on and poke holes
